commits.subject: composite + harness (SMB-COMPOSITE-STROKE-GEOMETRY slice 1): stroke rows with their own geometry
nib + harness (SMB-COMPOSITE-STROKE-GEOMETRY slices 2-3): exact crossings, pen joins network edges

capabilities_done: slice 1 composite FillPaint::StrokeGeometry { outline: Vec<OwnedPath>, paint }: a stroke row painted inside its own filled outline (paths united by nib, each under its own fill rule) with its own coverage plane (StrokePlane), following the fill rows; the plane rect covers outlines beyond the fill geometry; typed refusals vector_stroke_paint (stroke / stroke-geometry / image paint), vector_stroke_order (fill after a stroke), vector_geometry (non-finite or invalid outline), vector_nib_budget; empty outline = zero coverage. Existing Stroke rows unchanged (RowStroke::Style).

slice 1 proof: shared scene tests/support/stroke_geometry_scene.rs (fill rectangle, a two-band united solid stroke-geometry row and a gradient stroke-geometry row reaching beyond the fill) against the shared oracle (vector_scenes.rs: pigment composite_over over nib planes): render-cpu bit-exact (max |delta| 0), identical on chunk/thread variants (5,1)(7,4)(4,8)(64,2), digest pinned 73a61646...; render-gpu max |delta| 5.96e-8 <= 2e-6 on the live adapter

slice 1 harness: network and variable-width layers draw a fill row over the fill geometry and a StrokeGeometry row over the stroke outline; the blended colour tile of SMB-ILLUSTRATOR-PEN-3 is removed (viewer_vector_4 asserts exact fill/stroke pixels next to the stroke edge)

slice 2 nib::intersect: cubic_crossings (Bezier subdivision with the convex-hull box interval bound, exact halving, eps per axis, merged near-duplicates, MAX_CROSSING_WORK so coincident curves refuse BudgetExceeded), exact line_line, line_cubic, is_straight; network::planarize uses it for every segment pair (eps = tolerance / 4) and freeform::knife_strokes for every cut piece (eps 1e-9) instead of 64 samples

slice 3 nib network: hit (vertex, else segment point), split_segment (exact de Casteljau; straight segments split at their evaluated point; region loops lengthened in walk order), pen(from, point, drag, radius) joining an existing vertex, splitting the edge under the click or adding a vertex, connected to the previous pen vertex (drag = tangent); harness: the pen on a network layer (pen layer or selected) extends the network, one chronicle transaction per click, pen_vertex kept until pen_end / tool change

tests.argv: 7671aaf: cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-composite -p hsk-studio-render-cpu -p hsk-studio-render-gpu -p hsk-studio-harness --features hsk-studio-harness/viewer -E 'binary(stroke_geometry) | binary(vector_stroke_geometry) | binary(vector_nib) | binary(viewer_vector_3)' (13/14, then the pinned digest committed and render-cpu vector_stroke_geometry 1/1); 6fed566: cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-nib -p hsk-studio-harness --features hsk-studio-harness/viewer -E 'binary(intersect) | binary(network_pen) | binary(pen3) | binary(network) | binary(viewer_vector_4) | binary(viewer_vector_3) | binary(viewer_vector)' 23/23

next: Validator: judge the lane (round features: render-gpu needs the adapter per tests/gpu-proof.toml). spec_basis.STU-VEC-020: Stroke rendering (stroke rows with their own geometry)

notes.exactness: crossings are located to the interval bound eps (every true crossing lies in a reported pair's boxes); near-miss T-junction detection in planarize still samples 64 points (distance test, tolerance-bounded); tangential touches are reported as crossings within eps
gaps: composite's Folio adapter does not read networks (the harness builds the specs)
pen on networks makes straight or single-tangent segments; per-vertex cap/join overrides are stored, not rendered
